description: AICTIONBOT™ scenario calculator by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T14 (supplier commercial scenarios). Takes up to 12 offers with a unit price or price tiers (all-units or incremental), one-off costs such as tooling or setup, freight per unit, a volume rebate with its threshold and a cash discount, and the volumes to compare. Returns the total cost and cost per unit for each offer and volume, the cheapest offer per volume range with the exact tipping points, and for the negotiation the unit price each other offer would need to match the cheapest at the reference volume (useful as input for the negotiation sparring). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

offers.description: One object per offer: supplier, unit_price or tiers [{from, price}], tier_mode (all_units or incremental, default all_units), fixed_cost, freight_per_unit, bonus_percent, bonus_from (volume), payment_discount_percent.

quantities.description: Volumes to compare, e.g. [500, 1000, 2000]. Default: the tier thresholds.

reference_qty.description: Volume for the negotiation targets; must be one of quantities. Default: the largest.

name: compare_scenarios
title: Compare commercial scenarios: volume against price, tiers, one-off costs, freight, rebate and cash discount, with the cheapest offer per volume range
